denominators.failure_policy: Copy archived strict_choice_v1 status/correctness; all failures count as incorrect, never drop rows or reparse outputs. Missing exports retain explicit missing_prediction rows.

selection.objective: highest dev correct count; tie order cosine,random,utility
selection.frozen_test: evaluation only; previously observed, not new blind test

paths.P3: per-model fixed strategy chosen by dev correct count only
paths.P4: per-question max archived correctness among cosine/random/utility; post hoc Oracle upper bound, never deployable; keep separately identified

bootstrap.unit: existing query-or-shared-GT-image connected components; image association proxy, not verified document source
bootstrap.estimand: question-weighted right-minus-left accuracy percentage points; ratio of cluster sums to cluster sizes
bootstrap.rng: numpy.default_rng(42), shared draws within each family

multiplicity.method: Holm step-down adjusted two-sided centered-bootstrap p-values
multiplicity.Q3_family: all six path pairs per model, five models:30; post hoc Oracle pairs flagged separately
multiplicity.Q4_family: 15 within-model strategy pairs plus five predefined P3 cross-model comparisons:20
multiplicity.holm_confidence_interval: Simultaneous rectangle from inversion of the full-family Holm acceptance region; its rectangular projections equal basic-bootstrap Bonferroni intervals at alpha/m. Report this identity explicitly; do not call rank-dependent unadjusted quantiles Holm CIs.
multiplicity.monte_carlo_limit: 10000 draws; tail resolution finite; all intervals descriptive, no causal or equivalence claim

mechanism.scope: operational exact-image-identity/outcome classification; no semantic support or causal attribution
mechanism.retrieval_harm_proxy: archived S0 correct AND selected strategy incorrect; associative contrast only
mechanism.not_retrieved: no exact GT image in the no-self top10 pool, after harm priority
mechanism.present_but_wrong: top10 has exact GT but strategy incorrect, after prior classes
mechanism.extras: Also emit selected-top3-hit and pool-hit flags in aggregate; fixed split denominator and category partition must reconcile

concept_mapping.review: All mappings need independent review. Scenario taxonomy alone cannot identify OCR/chart; leave those empty instead of inventing labels. Compare to all-other conservative mapping.
concept_mapping.claim: 概念映射，未经独立标注审定

wording.oracle: post hoc upper bound; separate from deployable choices
forbidden: semantic accuracy inferred from citation F1
edge cost inferred from server cost

future_gates.R23: Historical paired-delivery status retained. New research analyses require 564 components/10000 resamples/seed42 and full-family correction under this contract.
future_gates.R25: Historical offline-generation Pareto delivery retained. A same-load full end-to-end Pareto requires future approved GPU measurements.
future_gates.R35: P1 approval/publication is conversation state, not a deficiency in historical code/environment hash and receipt delivery.

completion_counting: status only; 已完成/已交付/已披露/已执行 -> 完成; 部分 -> 部分; 后置 or 未测或不适用本轮 -> 后置; 待/未 -> 待补; qualified delivery retains its status; limit never changes grouping
